spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Been, become.
2 Being, existing.
3 Gone, past.
4 (In composition,) Like, resembling.
5 Obtained, got.
6 Proper, right.
7

True.
8

Known.
mn. (-तः-तं)
1 A goblin, a ghost, a malignant spirit, haunting cemeteries, lurking in trees, animating carcases, and deluding or devouring human beings.
2 A living being.
m. (-तः)
1 A son, a child.
2 A demigod of a particular class.
3 The fourteenth day of the dark half of the lunar month.
4 A name of ŚIVA.
n. (-तं)
1 An element; five Bhūtas are enumerated: earth, fire, water, air, and Ākāśa or æther.
2 (In law,) Fact, matter of fact, the real state of the case, or what has actually been.
E.
भू to be, aff. क्त of the participle past.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Root of sweet flag.
E.
भूत a spirit, and केश hair.

f. (-न्तिः)
Possession by evil spirits.
E.
भूत a goblin, क्रान्ति going.

m. (-णः)
A class of sprites or goblins.
E.
भूत, and गण a troop.

f. (-न्धा)
Murā, a sort of perfume.
E.
भूत a goblin, and गन्ध a perfume; used perhaps in the ceremonies with which those beings are worshipped.

m. (-मः)
Any aggregate of elementary matter, the body, the world.
E.
भूत, and ग्राम a heap.

m. (-घ्नः)
1 A camel.
2 Garlic.
f. (-घ्नी)
1 A plant, commonly Muṇḍīrī
2 Holy basil.
E.
भूत a sprite, and घ्न what destroys or removes.

f. (-टा)
Indian spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.)
E.
भूत a goblin, and जटा clustered locks.

f. (-या)
Compassion or tenderness to all creatures.
E.
भूत, and दया clemency.

f. (-त्री)
The earth.
E.
भूत a living being, and धात्री a nurse.

m. (-थः)
ŚIVA.
E.
भूत a spirit or element, and नाथ lord.

f. (-का)
DURGĀ.
E.
भूत a spirit, and नायिका leader.

m. (-नः)
1 Marking-nut plant, (Semicarpus anacardium.)
2 Mustard.
n. (-नं)
The Eleocarpus seed.
E.
भूत a goblin, and नाशन dispelling.

m. (-ष्पः)
A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)
E.
भूत a sprite, पुष्प a flower.

f. (-मा)
Day of full moon in Aśvin.
E.
भूत a sprite, and पूर्णिमा full moon: the Bhūtas being worshipped.

ind.
Formerly.

f. (-लिः)
Throwing the remnants of an offering on the ground for animals or outcastes, &c.
E.
भूत, and बलि an offering.

mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ)
Supporting the elements, living beings, &c.
E.
भूत, and भर्त्तृ who cherishes.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Elementary.
E.
भूत, and भाव nature.

mfn. (-भृत्)
Supporting the elements, living beings, &c.
E.
भूत, and भृत् sustaining.

nf. (-त्रं-त्रा)
The rudiment of an element.
E.
भूत, and मात्र element.

m. (-ज्ञः)
1 Offering viands, &c. to all created beings.
2 Worshipping evil spirits.
E.
भूत, and यज्ञ sacrifice.

n. (-लं)
The earth, the face of the earth.
E.
भू, and तल below.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Being, been.
E.
भू to be, क्तवतु aff.

m. (-सः)
Beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica.)
E.
भूत a goblin, and वास abode.

m. (-सः)
The body.
E.
भत, and आवास abode.

f. (-या)
Epilepsy, possession by evil spirits.
E.
भूत, and विक्रिया change.

f. (-शी)
A species of the Nebāri, (Nyctanthes tristis,) with white flowers.
E.
भूत a goblin, विश to pervade, अण् and ङीप् aff.

m. (-क्षः)
1 A tree, (Trophis aspera.)
2 A species of Bignonia, (B. Indica.)
E.
भूत a goblin, and वृक्ष a tree.

m. (-रः)
The world of mortals.
E.
भूत a sentient being, and संसार world.

m. (-र्गः)
Elementary nature.
E.
भूत, and सर्ग nature.

m. (-रः)
Possession by evil spirits.
f. (-री)
Fire in a forest.
E.
भूत a goblin, सम् with चर to go, aff. घञ्; also f. (-रिणी.)

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्त)
Combined with elementary matter.
E.
भूत, and सम्पृक्त united.

m. (-वः)
A deluge, a drowning of the world.
E.
भूत all beings, and सम्प्लव swimming, floating.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Residing or existing in the elements.
E.
भूत, and स्थ what stays.

m. (-त्मा)
1 The body.
2

BRAHMĀ.
3
A name of Ś

IVA.
4

War, conflict.
5 The elementary or vital principle, or the proximate cause of life and action.
E.
भूत an element, आत्मन् self or soul.

m. (-दिः)
God, the originator of beings.
E.
भूत, and आदि first.

m. (-रिः)
Asafœtida.
E.
भूत, and अरि a foe.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
Possessed by an evil spirit.
E.
भूत a spirit, आर्त्त pained.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Occupied or possessed by a devil.
E.
भूत a spirit, आविष्ट entered.

m. (-शः)
Possession by a devil or evil spirit.
E.
भूत a goblin, and आवेश entrance.

f. (-तिः)
1 Power, dignity.
2 Superhuman power, as attributable to ŚIVA especially, and attainable by the practice of austere and magical rites.
3 Prosperity, success.
4 Production, birth.
5

Ashes.
6

Fried meat.
7 The rut of elephants.
8 State of being, &c.
E.
भू to be, aff. क्तिच्.

m. (-कं)
1 A sort of gentian, (G. cherayta.)
2 A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schœnanthus.)
3 Another kind of grass.
4 A medicinal plant, commonly

Kayaphal.
5

Ligusticum ajwaen.
E.
भूत being or spirit, &c. aff. ठक्; also भूतीक.

m. (-कं)
1 A sort of gentian.
2 A kind of lovage, (Ligusticum ajwaen.)
2 A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schoenanthus.)
4 Another sort of grass.
E.
भूत being, aff. ईकक्, otherwise भूतिक.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Desirous of wealth, aggrandisement, &c.
m. (-मः)
1 A king's counsellor, a minister of state.
2 VṚHASPATI.
E.
भूति, and काम who desires.

m. (-लः)
1 A moat, a ditch.
2 A celler, a place under ground for concealing wealth, &c.

n. (-त्यं)
Any ceremony of a festive character, as a marriage, &c.
E.
भूति, and कृत्य rite; also भूतिकर्म्म, &c.

m. (-र्भः)
BHAVABHŪTI, the dramatic poet.
E.
भूति superhuman power, and गर्भ embryo, being resuscitate^1d by his contemporary, and rival KĀLIDĀSA, after having lost his life in an intrigue.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-नं)
The twenty-fourth lunar mansion, Dhaniṣṭhā.
E.
भूति prosperity, and निधान receptacle.

mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं)
A worshipper of spirits.
E.
भूत, and इज्या worship.

m. (-शः)
ŚIVA.
E.
भूत an imp, ईश lord.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Possessed by an evil spirit.
E.
भूत, and उपहत affected.

n. (-मं)
Gold.
E.
भू earth, उत्तभ best.

ind.
Having been or become.
E.
भू to be, क्त्वा aff.
